boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 130 chains a 10-wide upper grid to a separate lower counter frame through a lock-and-key mechanism — a blue lock and purple key tile sit in the center row, and matching them opens the feed lane between boards. The red rocket-marked blocks in the upper grid look urgent but are just traffic. Move them before the lock/key breaks and the lower green arrow lane seals permanently.
landmarks: Block Out Level 130 chains a 10-wide upper grid to a separate lower counter frame through a lock-and-key mechanism — a blue lock and purple key tile sit in the center row, and matching them opens the feed lane between boards.
The red rocket-marked blocks in the upper grid look urgent but are just traffic.
Move them before the lock/key breaks and the lower green arrow lane seals permanently.

quickTips: Keep the red rocket blocks parked until the blue lock/purple key pair breaks.
The lower frame counter drops from `20` to `17` as the upper grid clears — watch it before the final push.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Peel the top-row blocks using the blue up-arrow, then clear the green padlock tiles on the upper band.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Break the chain-linked right-side pair without shifting the red rocket blocks yet.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Match the blue lock tile with the purple key tile in the center row to open the lower frame.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Route the upper grid exits through the left red and right orange arrow lanes.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Spend the bottom counters `4`, `5`, and `1` to feed the lower `17` frame.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Clear the last upper scraps and zero the lower counter tile for the PERFECT clear.

failurePoints: Moving the red rocket blocks before the lock/key pair breaks — the lower green arrow lane seals shut.
Breaking the chain link while padlock tiles are still on the upper band.
